articles.title_en: Higher‐Order Income Risk Over The Business Cycle
articles.title_cn: 经济周期中的高阶收入风险
articles.abstract_en: We explore the consequences of higher‐order risk in a standard incomplete‐markets life‐cycle model. We calibrate the model using a canonical income process with persistent and transitory risk, extended to feature cyclical shock distributions with left‐skewness and excess kurtosis. We estimate this income process for U.S. household data, and find shocks to be highly leptokurtic, with countercyclical variance and procyclical skewness of persistent shocks. In the model, first, higher‐order risk has sizable welfare implications; second, it matters quantitatively for the welfare costs of cyclical idiosyncratic risk; third, it has nontrivial implications for self‐insurance against shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了标准不完全市场生命周期模型中高阶风险的后果。我们使用一个包含持久性和暂时性风险的经典收入过程来校准模型，并扩展为具有左偏和超额峰度的周期性冲击分布。我们使用美国家庭数据估计了这一收入过程，发现冲击具有高度尖峰厚尾特征，持久性冲击的方差呈逆周期性，偏度呈顺周期性。在模型中，首先，高阶风险具有显著的福利影响；其次，它对周期性异质性风险的福利成本具有定量重要性；第三，它对针对冲击的自我保险具有非平凡的影响。

articles.title_en: The Cost Of Trade Disruptions At Different Stages Of Development
articles.title_cn: 不同发展阶段贸易中断的成本
articles.abstract_en: We study trade disruptions at different stages of development in a two‐country, three‐sector model of Spain and United Kingdom from 1850 to 2000. The impact of trade disruptions depends on trade openness and the productivity gap between countries. A trade collapse today (more openness, less gap) comparable to the Inter‐War Trade Collapse (IWTC) decreases the capital stock threefold (12% instead of 4%) and lifetime consumption fourfold (1.58% instead of 0.37%). Capital accumulation amplifies the cost of trade disruptions. The IWTC promoted Spanish industrialization, while the opposite would be true today.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个两国、三部门的西班牙和英国模型中，研究了从1850年到2000年不同发展阶段的贸易中断。贸易中断的影响取决于贸易开放度和国家间的生产率差距。今天发生的贸易崩溃（更开放、差距更小）与两次世界大战之间的贸易崩溃（IWTC）相比，会使资本存量减少三倍（12%而非4%），终身消费减少四倍（1.58%而非0.37%）。资本积累放大了贸易中断的成本。IWTC促进了西班牙的工业化，而今天的情况则相反。

articles.title_en: Ending Wasteful Year‐End Spending: On Optimal Budget Rules In Organizations
articles.title_cn: 终结浪费的年末支出：论组织中的最优预算规则
articles.abstract_en: What can organizations do to minimize wasteful year‐end spending? I introduce a two‐period model to derive optimal budget roll‐over and audit rules. A principal tasks an agent with using a budget to fulfill the organization's spending needs, which are private information of the agent. The agent can misuse funds for private benefit. The optimal rules allow the agent to roll‐over a share of the unused funds, but not necessarily the full share, and in most cases to audit only sufficiently large spending. The optimal audit rule can change once fund roll‐over is allowed. Strategically underfunding the agent can be optimal.
articles.abstract_cn: 组织如何能够最小化浪费性的年末支出？我引入了一个两期模型来推导最优的预算结转和审计规则。委托人委派代理人使用预算来满足组织的支出需求，这些需求是代理人的私人信息。代理人可能滥用资金以谋取私利。最优规则允许代理人结转未使用资金的一部分，但不一定是全部份额，并且在大多数情况下仅审计足够大的支出。一旦允许资金结转，最优审计规则可能会改变。策略性地对代理人资金供给不足可能是最优的。

articles.title_en: Financial Dollarization In Emerging Markets: An Insurance Arrangement
articles.title_cn: 新兴市场的金融美元化：一种保险安排
articles.abstract_en: Households in emerging markets hold significant amounts of dollar deposits whereas firms have significant amount of dollar debt. Motivated by perceived dangers, policymakers consider regulations to limit dollarization. I draw attention to an important benefit of dollarization: it serves as an insurance arrangement in which firms provide income insurance. Emerging market exchange rates tend to depreciate in recessions so that households prefer holding deposits denominated in dollars. They effectively starve local financial markets of local currency; raising local interest rates over USD rates and causing entrepreneurs to borrow in dollars. This premium is the price paid by households for insurance.
articles.abstract_cn: 新兴市场的家庭持有大量美元存款，而企业则持有大量美元债务。出于对潜在危险的担忧，政策制定者考虑通过监管来限制美元化。我提请注意美元化的一个重要好处：它作为一种保险安排，企业在此提供收入保险。新兴市场的汇率往往在经济衰退时贬值，因此家庭更倾向于持有以美元计价的存款。他们实际上使当地金融市场缺乏本币；推高了当地利率相对于美元利率的水平，并导致企业家以美元借款。这一溢价是家庭为保险所支付的价格。

articles.title_en: Entry Barriers And Growth: The Role Of Endogenous Market Structure
articles.title_cn: 进入壁垒与增长：内生市场结构的作用
articles.abstract_en: We use China's growth experience as a laboratory to study how reductions in administrative and regulatory entry barriers contribute to growth. We develop a model of endogenous productivity and market structure with heterogeneous firms and frictional entry and calibrate it to Chinese manufacturing firms. We show that the reduction of entry barriers brings about 1.05 percentage points of productivity growth over the 1990–2004 period, accounting for 18.3% of the productivity growth in the 2004–7 period. A decomposition exercise shows that entry mainly affects growth through promoting a more competitive market structure, which more than offsets the negative Schumpeterian effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们以中国的增长经验为实验室，研究行政和监管进入壁垒的降低如何促进增长。我们构建了一个具有异质性企业和摩擦性进入的内生生产率与市场结构模型，并将其校准到中国制造业企业。我们表明，进入壁垒的降低在1990-2004年期间带来了1.05个百分点的生产率增长，占2004-7年期间生产率增长的18.3%。一个分解练习表明，进入主要通过促进更具竞争性的市场结构来影响增长，这超过了熊彼特效应的负面影响。

articles.title_en: Prominence And Market Power: Asymmetric Oligopoly With Sequential Consumer Search
articles.title_cn: 显著性与市场势力：序贯消费者搜索下的非对称寡头垄断
articles.abstract_en: This article presents a new perspective on the nature of market power through the lens of firm prominence. We build a model of oligopolistic price competition with sequential consumer search, showing that a larger firm sets a higher price than its smaller competitors. Consumers are more likely to encounter sellers from a larger firm both immediately and in future interactions, resulting in less‐elastic demand for that firm. Small firms can free‐ride on the prominent firm's market power to raise their prices and earn higher profits. The Herfindahl–Hirschman Index provides a useful guide for welfare evaluation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过企业显著性的视角，对市场势力的本质提出了新的见解。我们构建了一个具有序贯消费者搜索的寡头价格竞争模型，表明规模较大的企业会设定高于其较小竞争对手的价格。消费者在初次及后续互动中更可能遇到大企业的卖家，导致该企业的需求弹性较低。小企业可以搭显著企业市场势力的便车，提高自身价格并获得更高利润。赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数为福利评估提供了有用的指南。

articles.title_en: Intertemporal Consumption With Anticipating, Remembering, And Experiencing Selves
articles.title_cn: 跨期消费中的预期、记忆与体验自我
articles.abstract_en: We study intertemporal choice through a novel and flexible framework that accounts for savoring of future consumption and memories of past consumption. The model uses standard intertemporal budget constraints but enriches preference structures with utility from anticipation, remembering, and experience. We also present an internal commitment mechanism that ensures dynamic consistency. We provide a revealed preference characterization of this model and apply it to quarterly consumption data from Spanish households. Utility from anticipation is important—and time inconsistency not strictly needed—to rationalize consumption patterns in the data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一个新颖且灵活的框架研究跨期选择，该框架考虑了未来消费的预期和过去消费的记忆。该模型使用标准的跨期预算约束，但通过预期、记忆和体验的效用丰富了偏好结构。我们还提出了一种确保动态一致性的内部承诺机制。我们提供了该模型的显示偏好特征描述，并将其应用于西班牙家庭的季度消费数据。预期效用对于合理化数据中的消费模式很重要——而时间不一致并非严格必需。

articles.title_cn: 资产多样化与气候行动
articles.abstract_en: Asset pricing and climate policy are analyzed in a global economy where consumption goods are produced by both a green and a carbon‐intensive sector. Given that the economy is initially heavily dependent on carbon‐intensive capital, the desire to diversify assets complements the attempt to mitigate economic damages from climate change. In the longer run, however, a trade‐off between diversification and climate action emerges. We derive the optimal carbon price and the equilibrium risk‐free rate, and risk premia. Climate disasters significantly decrease the risk‐free rate but increase risk premia on financial assets, especially if no climate policy is implemented.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一个由绿色部门和碳密集型部门生产消费品的全球经济中，分析了资产定价和气候政策。鉴于经济最初高度依赖碳密集型资本，资产多样化的愿望补充了减轻气候变化经济损害的尝试。然而，从长远来看，多样化与气候行动之间出现了权衡。我们推导了最优碳价格、均衡无风险利率和风险溢价。气候灾难显著降低了无风险利率，但增加了金融资产的风险溢价，特别是在没有实施气候政策的情况下。

articles.title_en: Statistical Discrimination And Duration Dependence In A Semistructural Model
articles.title_cn: 统计歧视与半结构模型中的持续时间依赖性
articles.abstract_en: This article develops a job‐search model with unobserved worker heterogeneity and learning about worker types from unemployment duration. The model features negative duration dependence that stems from unobserved heterogeneity, skill depreciation, and statistical discrimination. We estimate job‐finding rates implied by our model using microlevel data from the Current Population Survey. We find that removing interview costs counterfactually, thereby eliminating statistical discrimination, substantially increases the job‐finding rates of the long‐term unemployed. The performance of low‐skill workers at the interview stage with discriminating firms plays a key role in explaining our counterfactual result.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个包含未观测到的工人异质性和从失业持续时间中学习工人类型的求职搜索模型。该模型具有负持续时间依赖性，这种依赖性源于未观测到的异质性、技能折旧和统计歧视。我们使用当前人口调查的微观数据估计了模型隐含的工作找到率。我们发现，反事实地取消面试成本，从而消除统计歧视，会显著提高长期失业者的工作找到率。低技能工人在与歧视性企业面试阶段的表现，在解释我们的反事实结果中起着关键作用。

articles.title_en: Uncertainty, Long‐Run, And Monetary Policy Risks In A Two‐Country Macro Model
articles.title_cn: 不确定性、长期风险与货币政策风险：一个两国宏观模型
articles.abstract_en: We study the currency risk premium and the forward premium bias in a two‐country New Keynesian model with production, no physical capital, and recursive utility. Monetary policy follows an interest rate feedback rule and exogenous total factor productivity (TFP) growth follows a long‐run risk process with stochastic volatility, which we estimate from data. With cross‐country heterogeneity in TFP and monetary policy, reasonable currency risk premia emerge under complete and incomplete markets but the forward premium bias is trivial. We diagnose the challenge faced by this fairly standard production model to explain the forward premium bias.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个包含生产、无实物资本和递归效用的两国新凯恩斯模型中的货币风险溢价和远期溢价偏差。货币政策遵循利率反馈规则，外生全要素生产率（TFP）增长遵循具有随机波动性的长期风险过程，我们根据数据对此进行估计。在TFP和货币政策的跨国异质性下，在完全和不完全市场下都会出现合理的货币风险溢价，但远期溢价偏差微不足道。我们诊断了这个相当标准的生产模型在解释远期溢价偏差方面所面临的挑战。

articles.title_en: The Ins And Outs Of Selling Houses: Understanding Housing‐Market Volatility
articles.title_cn: 房屋销售的进出：理解住房市场波动性
articles.abstract_en: This article documents the role of inflows (new listings) and outflows (sales) in explaining the volatility and comovement of housing‐market variables. An “ins versus outs” decomposition shows that both flows are quantitatively important for housing‐market volatility. The correlations between sales, prices, new listings, and time‐to‐sell are stable over time, whereas the signs of their correlations with houses for sale are found to be time‐varying. A calibrated search‐and‐matching model with endogenous inflows and outflows and shocks to housing demand matches many of the stable correlations and predicts that the correlations with houses for sale depend on the source and persistence of shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文记录了流入（新挂牌）和流出（销售）在解释住房市场变量波动性和联动性中的作用。一种“进出”分解表明，两种流量对住房市场波动性在数量上都很重要。销售、价格、新挂牌和售出时间之间的相关性随时间保持稳定，而它们与待售房屋的相关性的符号被发现是时变的。一个具有内生流入和流出以及住房需求冲击的校准搜索匹配模型匹配了许多稳定的相关性，并预测与待售房屋的相关性取决于冲击的来源和持续性。

articles.title_en: Monetary Policy Under Natural Disaster Shocks
articles.title_cn: 自然灾害冲击下的货币政策
articles.abstract_en: With climate change increasing the frequency and intensity of natural disasters, what should central banks do in response to these catastrophic events? Looking at IMF reports for 34 disaster‐years, which occurred in 16 disaster‐prone countries from 1999 to 2017, reveals lack of any systematic approach adopted by monetary authorities in response to climate shocks. Using a small‐open‐economy New‐Keynesian model with disaster shocks, we show that consistent with textbook theory, inflation targeting remains the welfare‐optimal regime. Therefore, the best strategy for monetary authorities is to resist the impulse of accommodating in response to catastrophic natural disasters, and focus on price stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着气候变化增加自然灾害的频率和强度，中央银行应如何应对这些灾难性事件？审视国际货币基金组织关于34个灾害年份的报告，这些年份发生在1999年至2017年间的16个易受灾国家，揭示了货币当局在应对气候冲击时缺乏任何系统性方法。通过使用一个包含灾害冲击的小型开放经济新凯恩斯模型，我们表明与教科书理论一致，通胀目标制仍然是福利最优的制度。因此，货币当局的最佳策略是抵制在应对灾难性自然灾害时进行宽松的冲动，并专注于价格稳定。

articles.title_cn: 努力供给中的来源依赖
articles.abstract_en: We examine source dependence in the setting of effort provision. Our first experiment elicits preference over uncertain piece rate schemes to perform a real‐effort task. Our second experiment elicits effort after receiving an uncertain gift. We vary the probability of winning and the familiarity of natural sources of uncertainty. We show that subjects are averse to unfamiliar sources for moderate or high probability, but less so for low probability. Moreover, effort exhibits more insensitivity to the probability under the unfamiliar source compared with the familiar source. Our findings support the validity and generalizability of source dependence in applied settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在努力供给的背景下考察来源依赖。我们的第一个实验通过不确定的计件工资方案来引出被试执行真实努力任务的偏好。我们的第二个实验在收到不确定礼物后引出努力。我们改变获胜概率和自然不确定性来源的熟悉程度。我们表明，对于中等或高概率，被试厌恶不熟悉的来源，但对于低概率则不那么厌恶。此外，与熟悉来源相比，在不熟悉来源下，努力对概率表现出更多的不敏感性。我们的发现支持了来源依赖在应用环境中的有效性和普遍性。

articles.title_cn: 边际内出行者与交通政策
articles.abstract_en: Structural models of traffic congestion, such as the bottleneck model, are used to answer important, policy‐relevant questions. However, existing models typically assume that no travelers are inframarginal regarding when to travel; that is, given equilibrium travel times, no travelers strictly prefer their ex ante departure time to all others. In this article, I address this shortcoming by incorporating inframarginal travelers into these models. This change significantly improves these models' ability to fit the data and changes policy prescriptions. In the case of congestion pricing, it typically changes the optimal toll by at least 25% and significantly worsens the distributional impacts.
articles.abstract_cn: 交通拥堵的结构模型，如瓶颈模型，被用于回答重要的政策相关问题。然而，现有模型通常假设没有出行者在出行时间上是边际内的；也就是说，在均衡出行时间下，没有出行者严格偏好其事前出发时间胜过所有其他时间。在本文中，我通过将边际内出行者纳入这些模型来解决这一缺陷。这一改变显著提高了这些模型拟合数据的能力，并改变了政策建议。在拥堵定价的情况下，它通常会使最优通行费改变至少25%，并显著恶化分配影响。

articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场制度与生育率
articles.abstract_en: Some high‐income countries have total fertility rates as low as one child. Using Spanish administrative data, we document that temporary contracts correlate with lower first birth rates. Also, women with children are less likely to work split‐shift jobs with long breaks in the middle of the day. We build a life‐cycle model where women decide on labor supply and fertility. We show that reforms eliminating duality or split‐shift jobs raise women's labor participation, narrow the employment gap between mothers and nonmothers, and boost fertility for working women. These reforms, together with childcare subsidies, increase married women's fertility to 1.8 children.
articles.abstract_cn: 一些高收入国家的总和生育率低至一个孩子。利用西班牙行政数据，我们记录了临时合同与较低的一胎生育率相关。此外，有孩子的女性从事中间有长时间休息的分班制工作的可能性较低。我们构建了一个生命周期模型，其中女性决定劳动供给和生育。我们表明，消除二元性（临时与永久合同分割）或分班制工作的改革提高了女性的劳动参与率，缩小了母亲与非母亲之间的就业差距，并提高了职业女性的生育率。这些改革连同儿童保育补贴，将已婚女性的生育率提高到1.8个孩子。
